+*/
+
+package database
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"strings"
+	"syscall"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/trace"
+	mssql "github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb"
+	"github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb/msdsn"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/defaults"
+)
+
+// SQLServerPinger tests connections using the SQL Server protocol.
+type SQLServerPinger struct{}
+
+// Ping connects to SQL Server and executes a basic query.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) Ping(ctx context.Context, params PingParams) error {
+	if err := params.CheckAndSetDefaults(defaults.ProtocolSQLServer); err != nil {
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	if params.Port < 1 || params.Port > 65535 {
+		return trace.BadParameter("invalid SQL Server port %d", params.Port)
+	}
+
+	connector := mssql.NewConnectorConfig(msdsn.Config{
+		Host:       params.Host,
+		Port:       uint64(params.Port),
+		User:       params.Username,
+		Database:   params.DatabaseName,
+		Encryption: msdsn.EncryptionDisabled,
+		Protocols:  []string{"tcp"},
+	}, nil)
+	conn, err := connector.Connect(ctx)
+	if err != nil {
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	defer conn.Close()
+
+	return trace.Wrap(conn.(*mssql.Conn).Ping(ctx))
+}
+
+// IsConnectionRefusedError reports whether the server refused the connection.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsConnectionRefusedError(err error) bool {
+	return errors.Is(err, syscall.ECONNREFUSED) ||
+		err != nil && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "connection refused")
+}
+
+// IsInvalidDatabaseUserError reports a rejected SQL Server login.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(err error) bool {
+	return sqlServerErrorNumber(err, 18456) && !p.IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(err)
+}
+
+// IsInvalidDatabaseNameError reports a missing or inaccessible database.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(err error) bool {
+	return sqlServerErrorNumber(err, 4060, 916)
+}
+
+func sqlServerErrorNumber(err error, numbers ...int32) bool {
+	var serverErr mssql.Error
+	if !errors.As(err, &serverErr) {
+		var serverErrPtr *mssql.Error
+		if !errors.As(err, &serverErrPtr) {
+			return false
+		}
+		serverErr = *serverErrPtr
+	}
+	for _, candidate := range append(serverErr.All, serverErr) {
+		for _, number := range numbers {
+			if candidate.Number == number {
+				return true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return false
+}

+*/
+
+package database
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"net"
+	"strconv"
+	"syscall"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/trace"
+	mssql "github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/srv/db/common"
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/srv/db/sqlserver"
+)
+
+func TestSQLServerErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	p := SQLServerPinger{}
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		name    string
+		err     error
+		refused bool
+		user    bool
+		db      bool
+	}{
+		{name: "nil"},
+		{name: "refused", err: fmt.Errorf("dial: %w", syscall.ECONNREFUSED), refused: true},
+		{name: "refused text", err: errors.New("dial tcp: connection refused"), refused: true},
+		{name: "invalid user", err: trace.Wrap(mssql.Error{Number: 18456}), user: true},
+		{name: "invalid database", err: trace.Wrap(&mssql.Error{Number: 4060}), db: true},
+		{name: "database inaccessible", err: mssql.Error{Number: 916}, db: true},
+		{name: "database error followed by login error", err: mssql.Error{Number: 18456, All: []mssql.Error{{Number: 4060}, {Number: 18456}}}, db: true},
+		{name: "unrelated", err: mssql.Error{Number: 1234}},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			require.Equal(t, tt.refused, p.IsConnectionRefusedError(tt.err))
+			require.Equal(t, tt.user, p.IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(tt.err))
+			require.Equal(t, tt.db, p.IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(tt.err))
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerPing(t *testing.T) {
+	server, err := sqlserver.NewTestServer(common.TestServerConfig{AuthClient: setupMockClient(t)})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	go server.Serve()
+	t.Cleanup(func() { server.Close() })
+
+	port, err := strconv.Atoi(server.Port())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	params := PingParams{Host: "localhost", Port: port, Username: "someuser", DatabaseName: "somedb"}
+	p := SQLServerPinger{}
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
+	defer cancel()
+	require.NoError(t, p.Ping(ctx, params))
+
+	ctx, cancel = context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	cancel()
+	require.Error(t, p.Ping(ctx, params))
+	ctx, cancel = context.WithDeadline(context.Background(), time.Now().Add(-time.Second))
+	defer cancel()
+	require.Error(t, p.Ping(ctx, params))
+
+	for _, invalid := range []PingParams{
+		{Host: "localhost", Port: port, DatabaseName: "somedb"},
+		{Host: "localhost", Port: port, Username: "someuser"},
+		{Host: "localhost", Port: -1, Username: "someuser", DatabaseName: "somedb"},
+	} {
+		require.Error(t, p.Ping(context.Background(), invalid))
+	}
+
+	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	addr := listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr)
+	require.NoError(t, listener.Close())
+	params.Host = "127.0.0.1"
+	params.Port = addr.Port
+	require.True(t, p.IsConnectionRefusedError(p.Ping(context.Background(), params)))
+}
